data.ruling: The refutation stands. The stock figures in the claim hold. What fails is the claim that the INA237AIDGSR passes rule 5 as the INA238's alternate, because a single offset calibration does not hold the offset. The INA237's offset is specified only at VCM 0 V (±50 µV max). Its CMRR is 120 dB min, which is 1 µV/V. On a high-side shunt the common mode follows the pack, so across 5 to 67.2 V the offset moves by up to 62.2 µV after any one calibration. That is 0.31 A on 200 µΩ and 0.62 A on 100 µΩ. It is more than the uncalibrated ±50 µV (0.25 A and 0.5 A), which the claim itself treats as failing V166. So V166 does not hold for the INA237 at any threshold P2 could have used. The INA238 (CMRR 140 dB min, Vos ±5 µV max at VCM 0 V and at 48 V) moves by 6.2 µV over the same span. The alternate also needs a per-board offset correction in firmware that the INA238 does not need, so it does not run on the same firmware configuration that rule 5 requires. The INA237's shunt gain error is ±0.3 % max, against the INA238's ±0.1 %. Neither route of rule 5 passes for the INA238 on the readings of 2026-09-29. The INA228AIDGSR has JLCPCB stock 0 with presale -174 and Digi-Key stock 0. The INA238AIDGSR itself has JLCPCB stock 1 with presale -94 and Digi-Key stock 0. Two conditions are not settled. First, the argument assumes a high-side shunt. The tree leaves the side open (IOBoard.md:469; V177 is marked for research). The tree points to high side: V54 puts the INA238's IN+ and IN- on the switched pack node, and V178 offers the external shunt's pack-side sense lead for VBUS. On a low-side shunt the common-mode term would not apply. Second, P2's own V166 value (quoted by the verifier as ±0.15 A below 15 A) was not read, because P2's return is not on disk in results or scratch. The ruling does not depend on that value, because the CMRR residual exceeds the raw offset that P2's own claim concedes fails.
data.evidence: INA237 (SBOSA20A, revised May 2022), section 6.5: CMRR 120 dB min (140 dB typ) for -0.3 V < VCM < 85 V over -40 to +125 °C; Vos ±15 µV typ, ±50 µV max, stated at VCM = 0 V only; offset drift ±20 nV/°C max; PSRR ±1 µV/V max; GSERR ±0.3 % max. INA238 (SLYS025B, revised May 2025), section 5.5: CMRR 140 dB min; Vos ±5 µV max at VCM = 48 V and at 0 V; GSERR ±0.1 % max. Arithmetic: 62.2 V × 1 µV/V = 62.2 µV, which is 0.311 A on 200 µΩ and 0.622 A on 100 µΩ. The INA238 gives 62.2 V × 0.1 µV/V = 6.2 µV. Uncalibrated INA237 offset: 50 µV, which is 0.25 A on 200 µΩ and 0.5 A on 100 µΩ. JLCPCB exact LCSC matches: C2887910 INA228AIDGSR stockCount 0, canPresaleNumber -174, expand (11:01:42Z); C2864837 INA237AIDGSR stockCount 5344, canPresaleNumber 5287, expand (11:01:43Z); C2868250 INA238AIDGSR stockCount 1, canPresaleNumber -94 (11:01:43Z).
